title: Miso salmon with pak choi
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Mix the miso, honey and soy sauce and brush it over the salmon.
Bake the salmon on a lined tray for 12–14 minutes.
Soak or cook the rice noodles according to the packet and drain.
Quarter the pak choi lengthways and sauté it with the spinach in the sesame oil for 3–4 minutes.
Arrange the noodles, vegetables and salmon and sprinkle with spring onions and sesame.
